title.narrative: CHR's Strengthening Human Rights Mechanisms in the Philippines Through Legislative Advocacy

description.narrative:
The proposed project, led by the Commission on Human Rights (CHR), aims to strengthen human rights protection in the Philippines through focused legislative advocacy. It seeks to advance a set of priority human rights measures for consideration and adoption by Congress, while also supporting the ratification of remaining international human rights conventions. The initiative will combine policy research, stakeholder engagement, and communication strategies to influence evidence-based lawmaking and institutional reforms.
Key activities will include a series of roundtable discussions with legislators, government agencies, civil society, and experts to generate dialogue and consensus on identified legislative priorities. The project will also develop advocacy and information materials, position papers, and policy briefs to support these measures, alongside regular progress reports tracking developments in Congress. By fostering collaboration and providing technical inputs, the CHR aims to strengthen national human rights mechanisms and ensure that domestic laws are aligned with international standards and obligations.
